card.name: Spatial relations in body-site descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, from, with, in line, away) that come right after a body or place landmark and introduce a second location or distance. Seen in injection-site and imaging-range instructions.

modes.label: Range between landmarks
modes.description: The word 'to' links the start and end points of a scanned or marked body region.
modes.example: Imaging is typically performed from the base of the pelvis<< to>> the base of the skull.

modes.label: Distance or alignment from a site
modes.description: A linking word follows a site and ties it to another site by distance or alignment.
modes.example: the injection sites should be at least<< >>2 inches away from each other.

card.plain: It fires on little words like 'to' or 'from' that link one body landmark to another when describing where to inject or scan.
